children: Gold falls in early Asian trade. Higher oil prices and strong U.S. industrial activity data reinforced expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve may need to keep policy tighter for longer, ANZ Research writes in a note. Rising yields and a strong U.S. dollar will likely keep the macro backdrop challenging for the yellow metal, the team adds. Spot gold is 1.1% lower at $4,237.21 an ounce.(kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
